top_deficiency_types.title: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Install an approved automatic sprinkler system.
Ensure smoke barriers are constructed to a 1 hour fire resistance rating.
Install emergency lighting that can last at least 1 1/2 hours.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Meet requirements for the use of electrical equipment.
top_deficiency_types.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Protect each resident from separation (from other residents, his/her room, or confinement to his/her room).
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.
